name: Electricity and magnetism: fields
description: Charges, fields, circuits, magnetism and light, taught at the Kepler outpost.
about:
Electricity and magnetism realm ("Electricity and magnetism: fields"): charges, fields, potentials, circuits, magnetism
and induction, for an adult who has finished Foundations, Calculus 1, Calculus 2 and Mechanics. Same Kepler outpost, now making
its own power: the Power Hall. Mira is still the mentor. The concept plan is docs/plans/EM-PLAN.md.

chapters.name: Charges and fields
chapters.blurb: Charge, Coulomb's law, the electric field and the field of a charged rod.

sector.name: Panel Field
sector.purpose: keep charged dust from clinging to the solar panels

chapters.name: Gauss's law
chapters.blurb: Flux through a surface and the shortcut it gives for symmetric charges.

sector.name: Shield Dome
sector.purpose: know the field inside and outside every charged shell

chapters.name: Electric potential
chapters.blurb: Energy per charge, volts, electron-volts and the field read off a potential.

sector.name: Accelerator Bay
sector.purpose: give each charged particle exactly the energy it needs

chapters.name: Capacitors and current
chapters.blurb: Storing charge and energy in capacitors, and charge on the move.

sector.name: Battery Vault
sector.purpose: store the day's power for the night

chapters.name: Circuits
chapters.blurb: Resistance, Ohm's law, networks, Kirchhoff's rules and charging over time.

sector.name: Cable Works
sector.purpose: run power to every dome without burning a wire

chapters.name: Magnetism
chapters.blurb: Magnetic forces on charges and wires, and the fields that currents make.

sector.name: Ore Sorter
sector.purpose: steer charged ore and lift steel with coils

chapters.name: Induction and light
chapters.blurb: Changing flux, generators, inductors, alternating current and light itself.

sector.name: Generator Station
sector.purpose: turn wind into power and power into signals

mentor.name: Mira
mentor.opening: I’m Mira. Charges and currents never stop moving, and we have to {purpose}. Your task is “{title}.” {brief} The idea we need: {topic}.
mentor.closing: You already have everything this needs from Foundations, Calculus and Mechanics. I’ll go through the worked example with you, and the guided steps are there whenever you want them.

copy.homeTitle:
Charge pushes, current flows.
Light is the result.
copy.firstVisit: The outpost runs on electricity now, and electricity is just charges pushing and pulling across empty space. Learn the rules for that push and you can build every panel, battery, coil and signal we own. First, the smallest thing in the Power Hall: a single charge.
copy.allDone: From one charge to a beam of light: the outpost's power is yours. Next, follow that light further in Waves.
copy.chaptersNote: Seven chapters. Learn every concept in a chapter to unlock a landmark for the outpost. Practice missions are optional.

skills.title: The skill tree
skills.text: Follow the prerequisite branches from charges to light. Each mission you finish opens the ideas that are built on it.

visual.title: The concept bench
visual.text: Pick any mission, change its numbers and predict the result before you check it. Nothing here affects your progress, and it all works offline.

help.title: Follow the charges, not the wires.
help.intro: Electricity and magnetism starts where Mechanics ends: with forces, energy and fields that reach across empty space. It teaches how charges push and pull, how fields and potentials describe that push, how currents move through circuits, and how changing magnetism makes electricity and light. Every new word and symbol is explained before you are asked to use it, with a worked example first.
help.answers: Answers are numbers with the unit named in each box, in the stated prefix where a power of ten is needed; angles are in radians, and a direction is typed as 1 or -1.
